articles.title: This Artist Turns Pumpkins into Spooky Sculptures
articles.summary: Pumpkin artist Ray Villafane sculpts gourds into 3-D characters, and his Halloween display in Gilbert, Arizona, runs through November 1.

articles.title: Chappell Roan Surprises Fans with Christina Aguilera
articles.summary: Chappell Roan brought out Christina Aguilera at her L.A. concert, where the two sang a duet of Roan's song "Coffee."

articles.title: Study: Younger Kids Feel More Excited About AI Stories
articles.summary: A UCLA study found that 10- to 13-year-olds are far more likely to feel excited, not doomed, about AI stories than older teens and young adults.
